svg.title: Blue White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection. Actual primary gallery page explicitly captions the reproduced painting Blue White (1962), oil on canvas, Rose Art Museum. Two blue masses nearly meet at the center; white wedges open at top and bottom. Different from the adjacent small collage Study for Blue White. Whole rectangular painted support retained; photo margins omitted. Physical dimensions remain unknown. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
